description: An employee is relocating from one city to another within the same country. They need to learn about housing, local registration, and schooling for their child.

user_profile.persona: 32-year-old software engineer, married with a 5-year-old child
user_profile.context: Moving next month, completely unfamiliar with the area

fact_sheet.fact: Alex Chen's apartment lease at 'The Aspens at Cedar Creek' begins on August 1, 2024.
The full address for the new apartment is 123 Willow Lane, Unit 4B, Cedar Creek, ZP 54321.
The monthly rent for apartment 4B is $2,250, due on the first of each month via the 'Appfolio' portal.
A security deposit of $2,250 was paid to 'Cedar Creek Homes Realty' on June 15, 2024.
The apartment complex has a 'no pets over 40 lbs' policy; Alex Chen's 15-lb beagle, 'Buddy', is approved.
The property manager for 'The Aspens at Cedar Creek' is Susan Vance, reachable at 555-0102.
The scheduled move-in time for Unit 4B is July 31, 2024, between 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM, using loading bay 2.
Realtor David Miller will conduct the apartment key handover on July 31 at 9:00 AM at the leasing office.
City registration must be completed at the Cedar Creek Municipal Building, located at 1 Government Plaza, Cedar Creek.
Alex Chen has an appointment for city registration with clerk Thomas Bell on August 5, 2024, at 10:30 AM in Room 104.
Required documents for city registration are: signed lease agreement, photo ID (passport or state ID), and proof of employment letter from Innovatech.
The deadline to update a driver's license with the new Cedar Creek address at the DMV is August 30, 2024.
The relocation specialist assigned by Innovatech is Maria Garcia, contactable at m.garcia@innovatech.relocation.com.
Alex Chen's 5-year-old child, Leo Chen, is enrolled in kindergarten at Cedar Creek Elementary School.
Leo Chen has been assigned to Mrs. Gable's kindergarten class in classroom K-2.
The first day of school for Cedar Creek Elementary is Tuesday, September 3, 2024.
Cedar Creek Elementary School is located at 456 Oak Avenue, Cedar Creek, ZP 54322.
The school enrollment packet required Leo's birth certificate, immunization records from Dr. Ames, and a copy of the new lease for proof of residency.
The school registrar is Ms. Linda Howell, and her office phone number is 555-0150, extension 102.
A new parent orientation is scheduled at the school auditorium on August 28, 2024, at 6:00 PM.
The internet service provider for the apartment is 'Connectify Broadband'.
A 'Connectify Broadband' technician is scheduled for internet installation on August 1, 2024, between 1:00 PM and 3:00 PM.
The monthly cost for the 1 Gbps fiber internet plan is $79.99 before taxes.
The electricity provider is 'Cedar Power & Light,' and the new account number is CP-87654321.
The estimated commute time from 123 Willow Lane to the Innovatech office at 500 Tech Parkway is 25 minutes by car during peak hours.
The Cedar Creek Transit bus route #12 stops at the corner of Willow Lane and Main Street, a 3-minute walk from the apartment.
The family has a new patient intake appointment with Dr. Sarah Jenkins at Cedar Creek Family Practice on August 12, 2024, at 2:00 PM.
The 'Aspens at Cedar Creek' community welcome packet includes a pool access key card (ID: AC-4B) and a gym access code (8520).

user_needs.description: When and where is my apartment move-in and key handover scheduled?
What is the full address of my new apartment?
user_needs.prediction_reason: After confirming the move-in time and location, the user will need the full address for navigation and administrative purposes.

user_needs.description: How much is my monthly rent and security deposit, and how do I pay the rent?
Which internet provider serves my apartment, and is internet installation already scheduled? If so, when?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After reviewing rent, deposit, and payment logistics for the apartment, a pragmatic user would naturally check a core utility next—whether internet service for the new home is already arranged and who the provider is.

user_needs.description: When and where is my appointment for city registration?
What documents are required for my city registration appointment?
user_needs.prediction_reason: After confirming the appointment details, the user's immediate next question would be about the necessary preparations and documents.

user_needs.description: When is my child's first day of school and where is the school located?
Who is my child's teacher and what is their classroom number?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Once the basic school details are known, a parent would naturally want to know more specific information about their child's class.

user_needs.description: When and where is the new parent orientation at the school?
user_needs.prediction_reason: After learning about the school start date, a key follow-up for a new parent is to ask about orientation events.

user_needs.description: What is the estimated commute time from my new apartment to the office?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: Once the user has confirmed their new home address (N2), a practical next thought is to understand the daily commute to their workplace.

user_needs.description: When is our new patient intake appointment with the family doctor?
What access items for the community pool and gym are included in my move-in welcome packet?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After confirming move-in and key handover details, a practical follow-up is to ask what access items or credentials come with the apartment's move-in welcome packet.

user_needs.description: Who is my company's relocation specialist and what is their contact information?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: While dealing with official administrative tasks like city registration (N5), the user may realize they need a point of contact for other relocation questions.
